description: This bar chart illustrates the average Shapley values for three language models—mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green)—across various relative positions to a probed target word, as indicated by the horizontal axis labels L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺. The vertical axis, labeled “Shapley value,” ranges from 0 to 80 on a linear scale, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 20. Each position on the horizontal axis has a group of three bars, one for each model, showing their respective Shapley values at that position. The tallest bar is for chLSTM at position T, reaching a value of approximately 80. The next tallest bars are for mBERT and XLM-R at position T, both reaching approximately 60. At position L₁, all three models have Shapley values around 15. The bars for positions L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺ are all relatively short, with values generally below 10, and the bars for R₃ and R₄⁺ are particularly low, with chLSTM at R₄⁺ showing a value near 0. The bars are not sorted by value; they are presented in the order of the relative positions from left to right. The legend in the top right corner identifies each model by its corresponding bar color.
